ns2:course.label: User Research & Evaluation
ns2:course.description: This course will teach students about user research and evaluation. They will learn to apply various user research methods, gather and understand user requirements and needs for a wide range of user populations, especially those that are under-served (e.g., children, older adults, people with disabilities), conduct user evaluations of prototypes and interactive systems, and communicate effectively about the research insights and make actionable design suggestions. Prerequisite: IS 204, or IS 226, or equivalent course.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: IS 204, or IS 226, or equivalent course.
